data.title: 加藤惠 · 傍晚通勤电车靠窗的晚霞·「耳机里……在放着我们游戏的主题曲哦」
data.description: 【傍晚通勤电车靠窗席】夕阳沉落的归途电车。白色耳机线垂在校服前襟，惠坐在靠窗座位上，原本看着手机屏幕的视线突然抬起望向车窗外的紫粉色晚霞，恬静的面庞倒映着落日余晖。
data.location: 傍晚返程通勤电车车厢
data.action: 靠窗侧坐，戴耳机从手机抬眼凝望窗外晚霞
data.lighting: 夕阳透过车窗切出的大块金橙与薄紫光芒
data.camera: medium shot, train window seat, earphones, sunset glow
data.promptProse: Megumi Kato sits by the train window with white earphone wires against her school sailor collar and red cardigan. She lowers attention from her phone to the violet-pink evening sky outside, short brown hair resting near the glass. The medium view includes the neighboring seat and receding carriage rail. Sunset cuts broad orange and lilac patches across her face and sleeve, with a softer reflected profile on the window surface.
